[[File:Concussion_cannon_turret.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A concussion cannon turret on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].]]

The '''concussion cannon turret''' was a concussion [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] used mainly by both the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. It was a large turret used similarly like anti-armor [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. The cannon would fire a pair of concussion energy balls at a vehicle or [[Tank/Legends|tank]], and would do serious damage to the vehicle if they hit. Although mainly used as anti-armor during the Clone Wars, they could also be used against large groups of [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] if aimed properly.
